test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six different cars, each of a different weight. Q is heavier than only one car. S is heavier than Q. R is heavier than P. T is heavier than S. P is heavier than T. Which car among the six is the heaviest?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six different cars, each of a different weight. 

1) Q is heavier than only one car. 

__ > __ > __ > __ > Q > __

2) S is heavier than Q. 

S > Q

3) T is heavier than S. 

T > S

4) P is heavier than T. 

P > T

5) R is heavier than P.

R > P

After combining all the statements:

R > P > T > S > Q

So, the final arrangement will be:

R > P > T > S > Q > U

Here, '**R**' is the six heaviest car.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
